from test_guard_publication import PublicationFixture
from research_workspace.runtime import Worker

try:
 c.submit();run=c.store.claim();token=c.store.guard.running(run['id'])
 before=c.store.guard.lease.durable_incarnation
 c.child("import json,sys;from research_workspace.store import Store;s=Store(sys.argv[1]);s.logout('unrelated-nonexistent-token');print(json.dumps({'published':True}))")

 try:
  worker.execute(run);result={'execute':'succeeded'}
 except GuardPaused as e:

 callbacks=[]
 token.launch(lambda:callbacks.append('fake-dispatch'))
 result.update(incarnation_changed=changed,existing_launch_gate_callback_count=len(callbacks),provider_calls=0,profile_version=3)
 print(json.dumps(result))
finally:
 c.tearDown();c.doCleanups()
